name: Being Ignorant
overview: Scripture reveals that ignorance often stems from a willful separation from wisdom and truth, as Proverbs 18:1 illustrates a man who isolates himself to pursue his own desires apart from understanding. In contrast, God imparts true knowledge and wisdom, exemplified in Daniel 1:17 where God grants insight and skill to His servants. John 8:44 highlights the spiritual root of ignorance in those who reject truth, aligning themselves with the father of lies, the devil, who inherently opposes all truth. Thus, being ignorant is not merely a lack of knowledge but a condition tied to one’s relationship with God and truth.
